title: IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.30153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Allen-Cahn equation is one of the standard phase-field models for mean-curvature flow (MCF), parameterised by the diffuse-interface width $\varepsilon$. Practical simulations span a range of $\varepsilon$, so a single model covering this range is needed. PDE-specific neural operators are accurate but must be retrained at every $\varepsilon$; general neural operators cover $\varepsilon$ in one model but lose the phase-field structure of the target. We introduce Interface-Augmented Diffusion-Reaction (IADR), a neural operator that addresses both shortcomings: a target network with a diffusion-and-reaction (DR) structure preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation, while a hypernetwork that maps $\varepsilon$ to the weights of this target network amortises the dependence on $\varepsilon$ across the range. A single IADR matches the per-$\varepsilon$ specialists on in-distribution data within the prescribed range, retai

translated_title: IADR：面向相场平均曲率流的界面增强神经算子
translated_abstract: Allen-Cahn方程是平均曲率流（MCF）的标准相场模型之一，由扩散界面宽度ε参数化。实际模拟涉及的ε范围很广，因此需要一个能覆盖该范围的单一模型。针对特定偏微分方程的神经算子精度高，但必须在每个ε处重新训练；通用神经算子虽然能在一个模型中覆盖ε的范围，却会丢失目标问题的相场结构。我们提出了界面增强扩散-反应神经算子，同时解决了上述两个缺点：具有扩散-反应（DR）结构的目标网络保留了Allen-Cahn方程的相场结构，而将ε映射到该目标网络权重的超网络则在整个范围内摊销了对ε的依赖。单个IADR在规定范围内的分布内数据上可与逐ε的专用模型相媲美，并且……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出界面增强神经算子IADR，通过扩散-反应结构的目标网络保留Allen-Cahn方程的相场结构，并用超网络摊销对界面宽度ε的依赖，使单一模型在整个ε范围内达到与逐ε专用模型相当的精度。
en_tdlr: IADR is an interface-augmented neural operator that preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation via a diffusion-reaction target network while a hypernetwork amortizes the dependence on interface width ε, enabling a single model to match per-ε specialists across the entire ε range.
